changed.title: Poisson thresholds for the number of largest extensions of mixed spaces after singular spacing-two mixing
changed.statement:
∀ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r → ∀ T D : ℕ → ℕ, Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
  (∀ k, 2 ≤ D k) → ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun k => 6*(T k : ℝ)/
    (1+Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^(D k)-1))^(2*r+1)) Filter.atTop (nhds τ) →
  ∀ j : ℕ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k : ℕ =>
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let t := T k
  let d := D k
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let next := fun i : Fin n =>
    (⟨(i.val+1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let h := fun (i : Fin n) (b : Fin 4) =>
    if i.val % 2 = b.val / 2 ∧ (i.val / 2 % 3 = b.val % 2 ∨ i.val / 2 % 3 = 2)
    then (1:F) else 0
  let good := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ b : Fin 4, (∑ i, h i b * x i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, x i * y (next i) = x (next i) * y i)
  let supp := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ∃ x ∈ U, x i ≠ 0)
  let spaces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Submodule F W)).filter good
  let layer := spaces.filter (fun U : Submodule F W => Module.finrank F U = d)
  let mixed := layer.filter (fun U => ∀ b : Fin 2, ∃ i ∈ supp U, i.val % 2 = b.val)
  let move := fun (i : Fin n) (v : ℕ) =>
    (⟨(i.val+v) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let exits := fun S : Finset (Fin n) => S.filter (fun i => next i ∉ S)
  let gap := fun (S : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) =>
    ((Finset.range n).filter (fun k => ∀ j : Fin (k+1), move i (j.val+1) ∉ S)).card
  let factor := fun g : ℕ => if (g-2) % 2 = 0 then (g-2)+1 else 1
  let hosts := fun U : Submodule F W => spaces.filter (fun E => U ≤ E)
  let topDim := fun U : Submodule F W => (hosts U).sup (fun E => Module.finrank F E)
  let countTop := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    ((hosts U).filter (fun E : Submodule F W => Module.finrank F E = topDim U)).card
  let small := fun S : Finset (Fin n) =>
    ∏ i ∈ exits S, if gap S i < 2*r+2 then factor (gap S i) else 1
  let event := mixed.filter (fun U => countTop U = small (supp U) * (2*r+1)^j)
  (event.card : ℝ)/(mixed.card : ℝ)) Filter.atTop
    (nhds (Real.exp (-(τ/2)) * (τ/2)^j / (Nat.factorial j : ℝ)))

changed.title: A small set of keys surviving early scheduled observations permits monotone exact counting through every later round
changed.statement:
∀ (k r d K : ℕ), 0 < k → d ≤ r →
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit i)
        (!(word.testBit ((i + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((i + 2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let constant := fun (j : Nat) => 3 ^ (k + j) % 2 ^ k
  let first := fun (t rowKey rowName : Nat) =>
    (List.range t).foldl (fun rowState rowIndex =>
      step (rowState ^^^ rot 1 rowState ^^^ rot (k - 1) rowState) ^^^
        rot (2 * rowIndex) rowKey ^^^ constant (rowIndex + 1)) (rot 1 rowKey ^^^ rowName)
  let second := fun (t colKey colName : Nat) =>
    (List.range t).foldl (fun colState colIndex =>
      step (colState ^^^ rot 2 colState ^^^ rot (k - 2) colState) ^^^
        rot (3 * (colIndex + 1) + 1) colKey ^^^ constant (r + (colIndex + 1)))
      (rot 3 colKey ^^^ colName)
  let V := Fin 7 × Fin k
  let P := V × Bool
  let keyLog := Nat.clog 2 (K+1)
  let B := 7*d+3
  let budget := 1048576*(k+1)^2*(K+1)^2*((k+1)*4^B+(r+1)+(keyLog+1)^2)
  let rounds := 128*(k+r+B+(keyLog+1)^2+1)
  let source := fun (a : P → Bool) =>
    [false,true] ++ List.ofFn (fun j : Fin (Fintype.card P) => a ((Fintype.equivFin P).symm j))
  let Gate := Bool × ℕ × ℕ
  let run := fun (G : List Gate) (a : P → Bool) =>
    G.foldl (fun (w : List Bool) g =>
      let l := w.getD g.2.1 false
      let r := w.getD g.2.2 false
      w ++ [if g.1 then l && r else l || r]) (source a)
  let N := 2 + Fintype.card P
  let depths := fun (G : List Gate) =>
    G.foldl (fun (w : List ℕ) g =>
      w ++ [max (w.getD g.2.1 0) (w.getD g.2.2 0) + 1]) (List.replicate N 0)
  ∃ (G : List Gate) (out : Fin (K+1) → ℕ), G.length ≤ budget ∧
    (∀ i : Fin G.length, (G.get i).2.1 < N+i.val ∧ (G.get i).2.2 < N+i.val) ∧
    (∀ j, out j < N+G.length ∧ (depths G).getD (out j) 0 ≤ rounds) ∧
    ∀ (u v : Fin k → Bool) (ρ : V → Option Bool),
      (∀ i, ρ (0,i) = some (u i) ∧ ρ (1,i) = some (v i)) →
      let bits := fun p : P => decide (ρ p.1 = some p.2)
      let word := fun (x : Fin k → Bool) => ∑ j : Fin k, (x j).toNat * 2^j.val
      let fits := fun (track : Fin 7) (x : ℕ) =>
        ∀ i : Fin k, ∀ b : Bool, ρ (track,i) = some b → x.testBit i.val = b
      let candidates := Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin k → Bool =>
        fits 2 (word x) ∧ fits 3 (first d (word x) (word u)) ∧
        fits 4 (second d (word x) (word v)))
      let accepted := candidates.filter (fun x =>
        fits 5 (first r (word x) (word u)) ∧ fits 6 (second r (word x) (word v)))
      (∀ j : Fin (K+1), (run G bits).getD (out j) false = true → accepted.card ≤ j.val) ∧
      (candidates.card ≤ K → ∀ j : Fin (K+1),
        (run G bits).getD (out j) false = true ↔ accepted.card ≤ j.val)
changed.unlocks: It counts shared witnesses through the full schedule when observed early states leave a small candidate set even with many unread raw bits.
changed.context: At site i both early bits use only key offsets from -3d-3 through 4d. With names supplied, a cyclic shift register retaining 7d+3 key bits can test both early reports. Label each edge by its appended raw key bit, using that site's hash column. Scan the two predecessors per state to recover singleton buckets, conditioned on either value of each key bit. Evaluate every later round on that bucket's one common key, test both outputs, and sort failed buckets. Only hashes certified singleton-or-empty may report count bounds.
